column3: Set the pace from the start - nudged along before the second last then a touch untidy at the final obstacle - rallied strongly to hold on
Settled in the pack early - driven up into third approaching 2 out then took second before the last - stayed on to finish second but unable to trouble the winner

Held up in the pack - hit the third - moved into second by the 7th - pushed along soon after - closed on leader before 2 out where errred - dropped back to third approaching the last - held on for third without finding more

Settled just off the pace early - moved up into fourth before the 8th and into third by the 9th - pressed for effort after 3 out but slipped back out of third before 2 out - faded quickly from there - finished fourth
Settled at the back - urged forward but toiling in 9th and out of contention throughout - finished 5th
Settled in rear early - lost place around 9th - eased out of contention before 3 out
Settled in the pack early - driven for effort before the 9th with little response - eased out of contention before 2 out
Held a forward spot early - slipped back around the 8th - needed encouragement to stay in touch - blundered and fell towards the back 3 out - faded and was eased out of contention before the last two
Sluggish start after keenness early - tracked front pair - pressed for effort with 2f left - finished strongly inside final furlong - hit front close home - prevailed by the finish
Settled at back early - progress made 2f out - pushed into front just over 1f out - stayed on strongly to inside final furlong - drifted left in closing stages and caught right at the line
Made the running - pressed for toe from 2f out - surrendered lead entering the final furlong - plugged on but couldn't match the first two - third
Tracked the pace-setter early - pressed for the lead 2f out - unable to improve position over 1f out - dropped away inside the last to finish fourth

Drifted left at the outset - fought for control early - settled midpack - pushed along and made ground over a furlong out - hit the front inside the last - drifted left again but pulled clear to score
Held up eager in the pack towards the back - shifted left and made progress from 2f out - pushed along over 1f out - stayed on late to grab second close home
Handy in the pack early - pushed along 2f out - hit the front briefly a furlong out before being overtaken - couldn't find more close home - edged out for second late

Pulled hard early - settled towards the back of the pack - shifted left after the opening furlong - moved left again with 2f remaining - pushed along a furlong out - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left and drifted left approaching final furlong - stayed on inside the last to finish 5th
Held up close to the pace early - pushed along with over 2f left - unable to find more inside final furlong - eventually finished sixth
Held up in the pack - driven approaching 2f out and drifted left - faded inside final furlong to finish 7th
Drifted left from the stalls - went straight to the front before losing command inside the last two furlongs - dropped away close home
Fought for its head early - tracking the pace before being asked for effort with 2f left - lost momentum and squeezed for space inside final furlong to finish ninth
Fought for control early - held up towards the back - shifted right with 2f left but couldn't land a blow
Hampered at the break - fought hard against restraint early - stayed towards the back for the duration - finished well held in 11th
Bumped at the start - travelling strongly in the pack - improved to track the front group 4f out - pressed along over 2f out - dropped away final furlong
Hesitant leaving the stalls - stayed at the back for the whole trip - well held in 13th
Set the pace from the off - pushed along after the second-last - allowed to coast home clear
Settled just off the front - pressed for effort approaching 2 out - stayed on but unable to match the winner
Sat in third early - pushed along before two out - unable to respond and beaten into third
Held up in rear - urged along before 2 out - dropped away soon after - eventually finished 4th well held
Tracked pace early - given a squeeze for effort 3f from home - urged on with 2f to run - locked in a battle from the furlong marker - got up close to home and held on

Set the pace early - urged forward with three furlongs left - driven out approaching the final two furlongs - locked in a prolonged battle from a furlong out - overtaken close home but responded gamely to the line
Slow to break - settled behind the front group - pressed for effort with 3f left and drifted left 2f out - stayed on at one pace to finish third beaten 5 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - kept plodding on late without closing further
Held up towards the back - urged to improve inside final 3f but never troubled the leaders - stayed on same pace to finish fifth
Settled close to the pace - pushed along and moved through to the front inside the final furlong - drew clear to score
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress a furlong out - drifted right approaching the line but stayed on to finish second beaten a length and a quarter
Race close to the pace - hit the front over 2f out before being overtaken with a furlong left - drifted left then drifted right approaching the line - held for third
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - lost touch and asked for effort with 3f left - made ground inside final furlong - kept on to grab fourth close home
Settled mid-pack early - urged forward approaching 2f out and gained ground inside final furlong - drifted left under pressure - held no more in reserve and slipped back to fifth close home
Hampered at the off - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - found extra and drifted left approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish sixth
Held a spot near the front - pushed along with a furlong left - lost ground close home to finish 7th
Drifted left at the break - settled midpack - driven approaching 2f out and drifted left again inside final furlong - held no chance and finished well beaten
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - found little as gaps closed - eventually well held
Held up at the back from the start - never able to close - finished well off the pace in 10th
Went straight to the front - lost command with pressure applied approaching final 2f - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 11th
Drifted right at the break - raced handy before being niggled along 2f out - dropped away final furlong to finish 12th
Slow to break - settled towards back before easing forward into 7th and driven on with 2f left - hit front a furlong out - kept finding under pressure to score

Held up towards the back - still down in 8th with three furlongs left - urged along soon after - unchanged in the pack a furlong out - strong late progress to third inside the last - kept finding through the line to snatch second by a short head
Sat behind the front pack early - pushed along in 3rd two furlongs out - briefly up to 2nd with a furlong left - dropped back to 3rd close home and held for the place
Settled second early - moved through to challenge for the front 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out - lost place inside final 2f - finished fourth without finding more
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with 5f left - up in 6th with 3f to go - slipped back to 9th approaching the final furlong but stayed on wide to finish 5th
Held up towards back of the field - improved into 5th and got going 2f out - into 6th with a furlong left - stayed on same speed to finish 6th
Settled towards the back of the pack early - pushed along in 8th out wide 2f out - unable to close - finished 7th
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along in 4th with two furlongs left - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 8th
Slow to break - held up in the pack early - improved to midfield by 4f - pushed along in 7th with 3f left before fading to finish ninth
Set the pace early - challenged 3f out and pushed along 2f out - lost command inside the final furlong - faded to finish 10th
Slow to break - settled just behind the front group - pushed along in third 3f out - faded quickly and allowed to drop away late
Held up early - up into third by the 8th - into second approaching 2 out - closed on the pace setter before the last - went on up the run-in and stayed on to win
Went straight to front - pressed for effort approaching two out - overtaken on the run for home and unable to reel in winner
Settled third early - moved into second by the 8th before being driven and slipping back before 2 out - faded to finish third
Held a forward position - travelling comfortably - came down at the 8th
Held up at back - urged forward 3f out then pressed for effort with 2f remaining - powered through to hit front inside final furlong - fought off rival to the line - held on by a whisker
Set the pace early - urged on with over two furlongs left - driven inside the final furlong - overtaken close home despite a determined battle to the line - narrowly denied
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward 3f out - under pressure with 2f left - lost position a furlong out - dropped away late to finish third
Settled mid-pack early - pushed along approaching final two furlongs - moved through to hit the front inside the last - stayed on to win

Held up back of the pack early - pressed for effort with over 2f left - found room and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on well to snatch second in the closing strides - unable to get to the winner
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack - pressed along 2f out - made progress a furlong out - briefly up to second inside final 110yds - edged back before finishing without response
Raced up with the pace - pushed along to close in for the lead over 2f out - stayed on through the last furlong - unable to add more in the closing stages finishing 4th beaten a length and a quarter

Knocked and squeezed for room early - settled towards the back - pushed along over 2f out - moved left approaching the final furlong - stayed on inside the last furlong - unable to add more in the closing stages finishing fifth beaten a length and a half
Sent clear from the start - pushed along a furlong out - lost the advantage inside the final furlong - unable to find more in the closing stages finishing sixth
Raced close to the front early - pushed along and improved a furlong out - lost momentum inside the final 110 yards - finished seventh beaten 2 lengths

Held up towards the back - short of room more than once approaching the final furlong - shifted left and pushed along then found some late progress - stayed on without threatening to reach the leaders
mid-pack early - pushed along and closed on the pace but drifted right approaching final furlong - lost momentum inside closing stages to finish 9th
Bumped at the off - settled towards the back - made ground into the race under 2f out - stayed on at one speed late finishing tenth
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along and moved through to challenge over 1f out - weakened final furlong to finish 11th
Sat close to the pace early - still in contention after a furlong - pressed for effort 2f out - drifted right and lost ground inside final furlong to finish well beaten
Drifted left at the break - raced handy before being niggled along over 2f out - dropped away final furlong to finish 13th
Stumbled at the off and almost lost the jockey - settled just off the pace - hit trouble and driven along inside the final furlong - faded to finish well beaten

Slow to break and urged on early - settled midfield - urged again into 7th with 2f left - 6th approaching final furlong - surged to the front inside it - kept up the effort to the finish - won going away
Slow to break and back of field early - moved up into contention after 2 furlongs - driven to the front 2 out - overtaken close home - held effort to the line for second
Held up towards the back - improved into 3rd 2f out and pressed on - briefly up to 2nd inside the final furlong - dropped back to 3rd close home - finished without further response
Sat just behind pace in 2nd - hit front two and a half furlongs out - pressed and lost advantage 2f out - slipped to 3rd with a furlong left - eased back to 4th late and held for no more
Slow to break - settled midfield - improved into 4th and driven approaching 2f out - held that spot inside final furlong - finished without response for 5th
Sat close to the pace - into 5th and pushed along 2f out - unable to close on the front-runners - finished 6th beaten 3¼ lengths
Slow to break - held up towards the back before improving to 6th and driven approaching 2f out - kept up effort but made no headway from there
Sat close to the front pack early - lost touch and slipped back to 8th over 2f out - unable to threaten - finished well held in 8th
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - urged forward early on - asked for more 3f out but made no dent on leaders - well held throughout to finish ninth
Struggled from the outset - unable to land a blow - well held throughout - finished 10th
Sent clear early - pressed for effort and lost front spot with about 2½f left - dropped away to finish well beaten in 11th
Handy early - hit front before the 5th then driven out approaching 2 out - stayed on strongly to score

Settled in the pack early - moved into second by the 6th but jumped awkwardly and slipped back - pressed on to reclaim second before 2 out - stayed on into last but unable to overhaul winner - held for second beaten 3 lengths
Settled in behind the pace - pushed along after 3 out - kept on late to grab third close home
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along and moved into fourth before 2 out where not entirely sure - soon dropped away
Pulled hard early and went to the front - overtaken but stayed close before 5th - back into second three out - eased back after pressure applied before 2 out - faded and blundered at the last
Held up in the pack early - briefly up to third before slipping back - pushed along after three out - dropped away soon after finishing sixth
Settled just off the pace early - dislodged rider at the opening obstacle
Set the pace from the start - held a clear advantage throughout - crossed the line with something in hand
Handy early - pressed leader from 3f out under pressure - unable to close 2f out and stayed on at one gait into final furlong - no more inside last 110yds finishing 2nd
Held up at the back - pushed along and fading over 3f out - dropped away steadily from 2f out to finish third
Settled in the pack early - close to the front with a furlong to run - kept up the effort inside the final furlong - edged clear to score
Pulling hard early - sat close to pace - pushed through to hit front inside final two furlongs - held on gamely but caught right at the line

Stumbled at the start - dropped towards the back early - stayed within range of the pace after a furlong - improved and pushed along to press the front around a furlong out - lost ground close home finishing third
Sluggish start - fought for control early - settled at rear - roused three out - made late progress inside final furlong - unable to close final furlong
Settled in a strong grip early - tracked the pace in second - pushed along to move ahead approaching 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left and faded
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - unable to close from over 1f out - eventually finished sixth beaten under five lengths
Went straight into the lead - pressed for effort and lost command approaching 2f out then quickly lost ground - well adrift with a furlong left and finished well held in 7th

Sat just off the front group early - moved through to hit the front over 2f out - driven along with a furlong and a half left - opened a gap approaching the final furlong - stayed on to the line despite edging in late
Settled midfield early - moved into third and driven with two out - into second and urged approaching the final furlong and a half - responded gamely to finish narrowly second
Sat close to the front pair - asked for effort 2f out - third and driven with a furlong and a half left - stayed on gamely in the closing stages but couldn't get to the front two
Held a midfield berth early - nudged for effort and 8th with 2f left - stayed 7th entering the final furlong - stuck on late to finish 4th unable to challenge
Sluggish start - back in the pack early - improved into 7th under pressure with 2f left - up to 5th a furlong out but couldn't find more - held on for 5th
Held up towards the back of the field - improved into 5th and driven approaching 2f out - 4th with a furlong left - held no more late and finished 6th beaten 3 1/4 lengths
Held up towards the back - improved into 10th under pressure 2f out - up to 6th with a furlong left - held on for 7th
Held up towards the back - urged into effort in 9th with 2f left - couldn't find extra pace and finished well held
Went straight to the front pulling hard early - lost the advantage under pressure inside the last two furlongs - faded quickly after and beaten well
Settled just behind the pace early - pushed along and slipped back to 6th approaching 2f out - lost touch through the closing stages
Held up in the pack - under pressure into 11th spot 2f out - couldn't find any extra late - well held at the finish
Held up early - failed to land a blow - beaten a long way from home - finished a well-held 12th
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out - dropped away late - finished well held in 13th
Settled midpack early - failed to make headway from 3f out - dropped away steadily through the finish
Settled just off the pace early - moved through after the 12th - into second place approaching two out - driven to the front before the last and kept going to win
Handy in the pack - roused to hit the front approaching two out then overtaken close to the last - battled on to finish second
Settled at back early - made progress from three out - pushed along after two out and pressed for second before the last - stayed on same rate to finish third
Held up in the pack - pushed along after the second-last - stayed on late but never in contention - finished fourth
Held a spot in the pack - pushed along after three out and up to fifth before the last - unable to make further headway late finishing 5th
Settled at the back early - urged forward after 3 out and edged past tiring runners before the last - could not land a threat late
Set the pace early - driven to stay in front before losing top spot approaching 2 out - dropped away steadily after that - eventually well beaten in 7th
Settled in the pack early - moved into third by the 9th before being pushed along after three out - dropped away from third and faded approaching the last two furlongs
Sat close up early - blundered 9th and slipped back - stumbled again 12th and fell towards the tail - pulled up before 3 out
Settled on own down the middle - tracking pace close up - shaken up to hit front approaching 3f out - urged forward inside final furlong - kept finding more to the line - held on for the win

Detached in the field - nudged along and made ground from 3f out without threatening - ran on strongly inside the final furlong to pursue the front runner late - kept on for 2nd but a length adrift at the line
Sat up behind the pacesetter - pushed along with two furlongs left - held effort through to the line for third
Drifted right early - settled mid-pack - found improvement but boxed in 3f out - driven approaching 2f out - urged over a furlong out - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth
Held up in the front rank - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find more from the final furlong - finished 5th
Bumped at the off - regained stride and went clear early - pressed and lost front spot 3f out - form dropped away quickly - faded inside final furlong to finish sixth
Clumsy start - keen and pulling hard early - settled at the back - pressed for effort 3f out with nothing to give - dropped away and allowed to drop into a canter approaching 2f out
Set the pace from the outset - pushed along with 2f remaining - stayed on well inside the last to hold on and win
Hampered at the break - settled towards the back of the pack - made smooth progress from over 3f out - pressed on into the final stages but unable to reel in the winner
Settled at the back pulling hard early - made smooth progress from 2f out under pressure - moved into third inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third
Settled at the back early - urged forward approaching 2f out - made progress but drifted left inside final furlong - kept responding to the line finishing fourth
Settled close to the pace early - up with the front rank with 5f left - pressed for effort inside the last 2f - faded in the closing stages to finish fifth
Drifted right at the off - settled handy then pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at one tempo late to finish sixth
Sluggish start - held up towards the back pulling hard - moved left approaching 2f out - pushed along with a furlong left but unable to close finished 7th beaten just under 6 lengths

Pulled hard early - settled in the pack - squeezed for space and lost ground back through the field over 2f out - shifted right a furlong out - finished with a late rally to the line finishing 8th beaten 6 lengths
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort 2f out - drifted right and found nothing over 1f out - finished ninth
Settled towards the rear early - failed to land a blow in the closing stages - finished tenth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close from over a furlong out - finished 11th
Held up in the pack - niggled for effort and drifted right approaching 2f out - soon dropped away to finish 12th
Held up close to the pace early - pushed along and dropped back over 2f out - fading when checked inside final furlong - well held in 13th
Drifted right at the break - fought for control early - up with the pace - pressed for effort 3f out then dropped away over the final two furlongs

Held up towards the back - improved into 8th on the outside 2f out - urged into contention approaching the furlong marker - up to second inside the last - finished full of running to get up in the closing strides
Sat behind the front group early - moved through to go on with two and a half furlongs left - driven approaching the last furlong - overtaken and unable to find more right at the finish
Held up towards back of pack - moved through to 6th and going strongly 2f out - pushed into 2nd a furlong out - edged back to 3rd close home and held for the same
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left and moved into 3rd - held steady effort to finish 4th
Handy in the pack early - pushed into second 2f out - slipped back to 5th final furlong and stayed on at one speed
Settled in the pack early - pushed along in 11th two out - improved to 6th but held late
Sat close to the pace early - pushed into 3rd with 2f left - slipped back through the field late and held on for 7th
Held up towards the back - urged into contention in 10th with 2f left - asked for effort but made no headway - finished well held in 8th
Dwelt at the break - settled near the back - driven into contention 2f out but made no headway
Settled in the pack early - pushed along in 9th approaching final furlong - unable to close and finished well held
Held towards the back of the pack - driven approaching 2f out but made no headway - well held at the finish
Went straight to front - pushed along and lost that spot with under 3f left - dropped away quickly after
Held up towards the back - made no headway from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up handy in the early stages - pushed along and slipped to 6th two furlongs out - faded to finish 14th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away late to finish 15th
Settled in the pack - unable to make headway from 2f out - dropped away late
Struggled from the outset - stayed at the rear throughout - finished well off the pace
Settled in second early - dropped a place 4 out then pushed along after 2 out - back into second by the last - powered clear on the run-in to score

Settled third early - moved into second 4 out - hit the front and cruised clear before 2 out - urged along and blundered at the last - denied on the run-in by a half-length despite battling to the finish
Set the pace early - pressed for effort before two out - overtaken soon after and dropped a place near the last - unable to resist late and came home third
Held up in rear - pushed along after 3 out - unable to close from 2 out - finished 4th
Settled at the back early - pushed along and made ground over 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong - kept going strongly to the line - comfortable success
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left and responded strongly through the last furlong - just denied close home
Held up early - pushed along and made ground over 2f out - kept going inside final furlong - closing well at the finish to be third

Slow into stride - settled just off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - hit front for a stride - overtaken with over a furlong to go - drifted right inside final 110 yards but stayed on to finish fourth
Sat close to front early - pressed for effort and lost touch inside final 2f - stayed on late to finish fifth
Travelled keenly early - hit front - pushed along approaching 2f out - lost advantage inside that - held on at one speed to finish sixth beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - lost touch inside final furlong to finish 7th
Set the pace from the off - given a nudge along with over 2f left - powered clear in the closing stages - scored comfortably
Sat behind the front group early - pushed along over 2f out and dropped to third with a furlong left - responded to finish strongest and regained second close home
Settled in the pack early - pushed along over 2f out and moved left - up to second a furlong out - unable to find more and edged out of the runner-up spot close home - held on for third
Sat close to the front group early - lost touch and roused with two out then drifted left approaching the furlong marker - stayed on at one gear to the line finishing fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back and eager early - bumped a touch just after the off - pushed along with 2f left then edged past faded runners inside the closing furlong to finish sixth
Settled handy early - driven and drifted left with 2f left - lost momentum and squeezed for space inside final furlong - faded home well held
Held in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - dropped away inside final furlong - finished well held in 8th
Held up handy in early stages - pressed for effort over 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 9th
Held up at the back throughout - never troubled the front and came home well beaten in 10th
Held up at the back from the start - never able to make an impression - well beaten in 11th

Held up towards the back of the pack early - moved up into 7th on the outside 2f out - pushed into 3rd approaching the final furlong and a half before hitting the front with a furlong left - kept going strongly to the line
Settled in the pack on the rail - urged into 8th with 2f left - improved into 4th a furlong out - claimed second inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish second
Settled in the pack early - moved into third and asked for effort 2f out - shared the front spot 1 1/2f out before being overtaken with a furlong left - held safe in third at the finish
Slow into stride - settled towards the back - boxed in around 2f out - pushed along and made headway to 8th with a furlong left - stayed on to finish 4th
Settled midpack early - improved into 5th and asked for effort with two out - shared front spot briefly a furlong and a half out before being overtaken - held no more in the closing stages
Slow to begin - held towards back - pushed along with 2f left - moved up into 14th wide of rivals with a furlong to go and stayed on steadily but never a factor - finished sixth
Slow to break - held towards back of field - pushed along in 14th with 2f left - improved to 9th inside final furlong but unable to close
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along in 5th over 1f out - unable to close final furlong
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final furlong and slipped to 11th - unable to close late
Sluggish start - held towards back - urged for effort with 2f left but made no headway - edged closer near the far rail late finishing 10th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left then slipped back to 10th approaching the final furlong - unable to threaten and finished well held
Close up early - shared front spot after 2f - overtaken at halfway - pressed for effort 2f out and dropped away late finishing 12th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left and 6th approaching final furlong - dropped away in the closing stages
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away late finishing 14th
Hesitant start - held towards the back of the pack - asked for effort with 2f left but made no headway
Settled in the pack early - eased back through the field two out under pressure - couldn't find further response and well held
Settled just off the pace - pushed along in 6th with 2f left - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Held around midfield - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away late
Went straight to the front - lost command before 2f - dropped away steadily from the 3f pole to finish well beaten
Near front early - shared the advantage after 2f before edging clear at halfway - pushed along and overtaken 2f from home - dropped away steadily to finish 20th
Set the pace from the off - stayed clear in front throughout - crossed the line easily
Tracked front-runner early - pressed for effort 2f out - held on at one gait late - outclassed by winner in second
Hampered start - pulling hard at the back - pushed along 2f out and dropped away
Sat close to the front pack - pushed along and moved through to hit the front inside the last two furlongs - stayed on well to the line
Pulled hard early - settled towards the back of the pack - pressed on approaching 2f out - drifted left with a furlong left - driven along and found extra close home - nabbed second right on the line
Settled in the pack - shifted left and pushed along inside final furlong - held the effort without further response late - edged out of second close home to finish third
Tracked the pace in a forward spot - closed on the front group approaching 2f out and pushed along a furlong later - flattened out in the closing stages to finish fourth
Took a strong hold up with the front group - pushed to the front 2f out - collared inside the final furlong and found nothing more - drifted left late to finish 5th
Set the pace early - lost the advantage and pressed for effort inside final 2f - dropped away in the closing stages to finish sixth

Dwelt badly at the off and trailed the field early - urged forward from 3f out - made ground and got going in the closing stages to pick off tired horses inside the final furlong - hampered close home - well held in 7th
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground early - settled with a strong grip on the bit in mid-pack - moved into contention 4f out - pressed for effort 2f out - lost place late finishing 8th
Held up eager to go back of the pack - pushed along with a furlong left - stayed on at one gear through to the line without threatening
Handy with the main group early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 10th
Held up in the pack pulling hard early - drifted left approaching the 1f pole - pushed along with 1f left and soon dropped away
Sluggish start - held up at the back throughout - never a factor - well held in 12th
Held up towards the back - brushed heels and lost rider after 1f

Settled just behind front group - asked for effort in 2nd two out - hit the front and went on at the furlong and a half - opened daylight briefly - had to be driven out and edge narrowed but held on for the win
Held towards the back early - urged into 7th with 2f left - made progress into 3rd approaching the final furlong - moved up to 2nd close home - finished full of running to just fail by a short margin
Sat just off the front pair early - pushed along into 3rd two out - slipped to 4th with a furlong left - back up into 3rd approaching the line - finished strongly but couldn't get to the front two
Sat closest to pace early - hit front over 2f out but soon under pressure - lost advantage 1 1/2f out - slipped back to 4th inside final furlong and unable to find more
Settled in the pack - pushed along into 6th two out then 5th approaching final furlong - held on for 5th without finding more
Held up early - pushed along and made ground into 9th approaching 2f out - stayed on late but never got competitive - finished sixth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along in 8th approaching final 2f - unable to close - finished well held in 7th
Settled just behind the pace - pushed along in 5th over 2f out and 6th approaching the final furlong - unable to close and finished well held
Held up towards the back on the rail - asked for effort with 2f left but made no headway - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack from the off - made no impression through the race - finished well beaten in 10th
Set off in front and opened a healthy gap - pushed along and lost the advantage over 2f out - dropped away late to finish 11th
Held up at the rear from the start - no impact through the race - beaten a long way home in 12th
Settled midfield early - urged for effort at halfway - soon lost touch and dropped away - finished well held in 13th
